title: System Rush
statusNote: Plays: logos, main menu, then races in 3D both ways: Story Mode (character choice, the comic-strip story, briefing, vehicle choice, first race) and Free Hack Mode (network, subnet, security level, vehicle, race). In the race the vehicle accelerates, steers, jumps, the camera switches and the pause menu works. The card's second app folder (6R63_1, a 416-byte stub) does not get in the way: the emulator launches the main app.
notes: The left soft key selects and the right one goes back; 5 and OK select too.
Story Mode opens with a long comic strip: each select press shows the next panel, about fifty presses before the first race. Free Hack Mode goes straight to choosing a network and racing.
In a race the left soft key opens the pause menu (Resume, Sound Settings, Restart Race, Quit to Title).
The keys can be changed under Options > Controls; that is on top of the bindings here.
Multiplayer and N-Gage Arena need Bluetooth or the online service and cannot work here.

controls.source: The game's defaults from Options > Controls (Control Configuration). Accelerate, turning, jump, the camera switch and the pause menu were also tried in a race; that 5 and OK select in menus was observed.

actions.lsk: Select in menus; pause menu in a race
actions.rsk: Back in menus (Quit on the main menu)

notes: Racing layout: turn on the arrows, accelerate on X or Space, use a pickup on Z, jump on C, switch camera on V. On a gamepad A or the right trigger accelerates, B jumps, X uses a pickup, Y switches camera and Start is the left soft key.
